summarize_DESCRIPTIONS: summarize the DESCRIPTIONS dictionary containing descriptions for Universal Dependencies treebanks
summarize_UD_FILEPATHS: summarize the UD_FILEPATHS dictionary mapping treebank configs to their train/dev/test file paths
run_prepare_ud_filepaths: run prepare_ud_filepaths to prepend a path prefix to a list of UD treebank file paths
review_prepare_ud_filepaths: review the prepare_ud_filepaths function that prepends a path prefix to filepath(s)
summarize_LANGS: summarize the LANGS variable containing all treebank config keys from DESCRIPTIONS
